http:request.doc:name: Get current forecast

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var weatherDescriptions = { "0": { pt: "Céu limpo", en: "Clear sky" }, "1": { pt: "Predominantemente limpo", en: "Mainly clear" }, "2": { pt: "Parcialmente nublado", en: "Partly cloudy" }, "3": { pt: "Nublado", en: "Overcast" }, "45": { pt: "Neblina", en: "Fog" }, "48": { pt: "Neblina com geada", en: "Depositing rime fog" }, "51": { pt: "Garoa leve", en: "Light drizzle" }, "53": { pt: "Garoa moderada", en: "Moderate drizzle" }, "55": { pt: "Garoa forte", en: "Dense drizzle" }, "61": { pt: "Chuva leve", en: "Slight rain" }, "63": { pt: "Chuva moderada", en: "Moderate rain" }, "65": { pt: "Chuva forte", en: "Heavy rain" }, "71": { pt: "Neve leve", en: "Slight snow" }, "73": { pt: "Neve moderada", en: "Moderate snow" }, "75": { pt: "Neve forte", en: "Heavy snow" }, "80": { pt: "Pancadas de chuva leves", en: "Slight rain showers" }, "81": { pt: "Pancadas de chuva moderadas", en: "Moderate rain showers" }, "82": { pt: "Pancadas de chuva violentas", en: "Violent rain showers" }, "95": { pt: "Trovoada", en: "Thunderstorm" }, "96": { pt: "Trovoada com granizo leve", en: "Thunderstorm with slight hail" }, "99": { pt: "Trovoada com granizo forte", en: "Thunderstorm with heavy hail" } } var code = payload.current.weather_code as String default "0" var desc = weatherDescriptions[code] default { pt: "Desconhecido", en: "Unknown" } --- { city: vars.location.name, country: vars.location.country default "", coordinates: { latitude: vars.location.latitude, longitude: vars.location.longitude }, temperatureCelsius: payload.current.temperature_2m, windSpeedKmh: payload.current.wind_speed_10m, description: desc, observedAt: payload.current.time }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "MISSING_CITY", message: "Informe o parâmetro 'city', ex: ?city=Sao Paulo" }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "CITY_NOT_FOUND", message: "Cidade nao encontrada: '$(vars.city)'" }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE", message: "Servico de clima temporariamente indisponivel" }
